_doc: Research groups for the units the history layer does not draw or draws only in part. Built by tools/build_groups.py from status.json (the layer as built now), roster-gaps.json, the Official Records index, the five position ledgers and the state-volume index. Every unit of the roster is in exactly one group. class: not_drawn | edge_only | partly_drawn | formation | not_on_field. missing: arrival | positions | path | strength | parent_only (PLAN.md section 2 defines each). why: the reason code of the layer (PLAN.md section 2). The data contract of the group files is PLAN.md section 5.
